# System Validation Report

**Project:** Collaborative Study Material and Quiz Platform (CSQP), Team 13
**Course:** UE24CS341A Software Engineering
**Generated by:** `docs/testing/generate-reports.mjs` (all figures come from this run)

## Test environment

- Run date: 2026-11-16 03:29 UTC
- Machine: Darwin 23.3.0 (arm64)
- Node.js: v25.1.0, npm 11.6.2
- Python: Python 3.13.5
- Git commit: 06c66c5 (docs/final-deliverables)

This report validates the complete system against every requirement in the SRS, using the Requirements Traceability Matrix from Test Plan section 13. The automated evidence runs each module end to end through the real Express API and a real (in-memory) MongoDB instance with Supertest, which is system-level validation of the API. The frontend suites render the real React components. The manual column is the walkthrough of each use case in the running application.

## Load test results (CSQP-NF-001, CSQP-NF-002)

Run with `UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=8`, the deployment setting recommended in `backend/loadtest/README.md`. API, load generator and test database ran on the same machine.

| Req | Scenario | Requests | Failed | p50 | p90 | p99 | Max | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NF-001 | Health check, 100 users, 1 request/s each | 1000 | 0 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 22 | PASS |
| NF-001 | Current user (JWT + DB read), 100 users, 1 request/s each | 992 | 0 | 5 | 9 | 12 | 19 | PASS |
| NF-001 | Login (bcrypt + DB read), 100 users, 1 login per 10 s each | 196 | 0 | 303 | 352 | 409 | 419 | PASS |
| NF-002 | Burst: 100 simultaneous current-user requests | 100 | 0 | 60 | 78 | 83 | 83 | PASS |
| NF-002 | Burst: 100 simultaneous logins | 100 | 0 | 2724 | 4559 | 4902 | 4915 | PASS |
